description_en: Query the agent list in the Cloud Customer Service System by AICCS instance ID and skill group ID
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、技能组ID查询悉犀客服工作台坐席列表
name: ListAgentBySkillGroupId

parameters.help_en: A unique ID for the Customer request. It is used for idempotency validation and can be generated using a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill group ID.  
You can invoke the [QuerySkillGroups](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups) API and view the **SkillGroupId** in the response parameters to obtain the skill group ID
parameters.help_zh:
技能组ID。

可调用[QuerySkillGroups](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups)接口，查看返回参数的**SkillGroupId**，即技能组ID
parameters.name: skill_group_id
